rfm.title: RFM mode
rfm.body: The ranking uses only recency (how recently the customer bought), frequency (how often) and monetary value (how much they spend), plus open tasks and stale deals. No machine learning is involved. The list shows who to contact; it does not predict what a contact will do.

ml.title: ML ranking
ml.body: The ranking uses uplift scores from the active model. The reasons say why a contact is listed. The scores are estimates, not proof of an effect.
